# v1.1.2 — Bug fixes and docs repair

## Highlights

- **Docs:** Restore `v1.0.x-to-v1.1.0` migration guide links (MkDocs strict build)
- **Parser:** Lenient import kind-conflict handling; dangling DL expression validation
- **DL:** Malformed XSD numerics; `from_json_with_limits` validation
- **SWRL:** EL taxonomy for class-variable rule bodies; `classify_for_swrl` ignores SWRL rules for EL profile checks
- **RL / EL / bindings:** Materialization clash reporting; `Profile::Auto` incremental EL; Python/JS query rewrite

Drop-in patch over **v1.1.0** or **v1.1.1** — bump all `ontologos-*` pins together. No breaking Rust/Python API changes.

## Install

**Rust:**

```toml
ontologos-core = "1.1.2"
ontologos-parser = "1.1.2"
ontologos-facade = "1.1.2"
```

**Python:**

```bash
pip install ontologos==1.1.2
```

**CLI:**

```bash
cargo install --git https://github.com/eddiethedean/ontologos --tag v1.1.2 ontologos-cli
```

**Bindings (source-build):**

```bash
cargo build -p ontologos-jni -p ontologos-dotnet -p ontologos-c --release
bash scripts/ci-bindings.sh
```

## Migration

- From **v1.1.0** or **v1.1.1:** bump pins to `"1.1.2"` (no API changes).
- From **v1.0.x:** see [v1.0.x → v1.1.0](../../docs/migration/v1.0.x-to-v1.1.0.md) first, then pin **1.1.2**.

Full details: [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md).
